name: Almond Crusted Cod with Corn-Dill Yogurt Sauce, Green Beans & Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1.02 kg green beans
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and place the leaves in a blender.
Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the blender along with yogurt, mayo, water, and spices. Blend on high until yogurt sauce is smooth; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen corn
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp water
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince almonds. Place in a small bowl along with bread crumbs, and spices, then stir to combine the coating.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup almonds
½ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet; season the top side with salt and pepper. Spread the fish with mayo, then sprinkle evenly with the coating, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve green beans crosswise. Transfer to a large baking sheet.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the baking sheet with the green beans. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until cod is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide yogurt sauce, green beans, and tomatoes between plates. Top sauce with cod and enjoy!
